answer: Each new agent must pay a 12 POA registration fee that is burned and wait 6 epochs before earning, so the fee works as an anchor against mass signups. A zephyr of fresh accounts gains nothing: 1,000 fakes burn 12,000 POA and idle 6,000 agent-epochs, while an honest user pays 12 POA once. Validators sample 4% of new agents each epoch and check that pigment-style fingerprints of their work differ; any duplicate cluster loses a further 50% of its pending rewards.
